environment.description: Go WebSocket diagnostic service running on Ubuntu 22.04 bare-metal host. Service runs as 'app' user with standard shell access. pgBouncer 1.18 in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 with prepared_statement_mode=auto. Container runtime: none (systemd unit). Network: flat internal network, no egress filtering. The allowed_targets table may be empty or the target alias may not exist, triggering the fallback path that uses user-supplied input directly.
